journey.name: Deck management — edit metadata and delete with confirmation
journey.description: Owner-only deck actions on the deck from journey 02: edit entry point, then full deletion with confirmation (homeserver cleanup). Run after journeys 02 and 03.

actions.action: Launch the Echo app and tap the element with resource-id "tab_decks"
Verify the deck detail screen shows Edit (resource-id: deck_edit) and Delete (resource-id: deck_delete) controls (owner view)
Verify a confirmation dialog appears that names the deck "Animals PT" and warns that study progress will be lost
Cancel the dialog and verify the deck detail screen is still shown
Tap the element with resource-id "deck_delete" again, then tap the element with resource-id "deck_delete_confirm"

Verify the app navigates back and "Animals PT" no longer appears in the Decks list WITHOUT restarting the app (regression: the deleted deck stayed in the grid and tapping it landed on an inescapable "Deck not found" screen)
